name: same-project-typescript-react-express-nodejs-api
description: Urban Planning Monitoring System (UPMS) - React, TypeScript and Express with seeded in-memory data

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test:api: npm --prefix server run build && node scripts/check-api.mjs
